Information re: G. Kuchmar

994
10-3-43

Gabriel ( alias George KUCHMAR
Soviet citizen of Jewish origin
Born on 1-8-1907 in Amur Province, Siberia.
Holds Soviet passport No.001 issued at Tsitsikar on July 26,
1926.
Single.
Arrived in Shanghai from Tientsin in 1936 (Deported?)
Chauffeur-mechanic.
In Shanghai worked mostly as a driver in connection with the
Oriental Express Co, 45 Miuxiang Road, manager of which, one U.S.
Beregovsky, is reported to be married to Kuchmar's sister. For
the past several months is reported to have been casually work-
ing as a commission agent. In the Pao Chia Registration form
gave his occupation as that of a "Merchant".
Until May 20, 1942 resided at 301 Cardinal Mercier, Present ad-
dress : 119 Route Vallon.
Guarantors (Pao Chia): Pelageya CHISTIAKOVA) both r side at
Maria kiseleva ) 119 Rte Vallon
Reported to be of little education.
Has criminal record:
(a) Driving without a licence Fined $ 10 or 10
11-6-37 days.
(b) Misappropriation 3 months imprison-
25-4-32 ment suspended
for 2 years
With the exception of an unconfirmed report to the effect that
he had been expelled from Tientsin, no information is so far
available to show that he is connected in any way with any po-

litical activities.

His brother Joseph Arcmey KUCHMAK, b. 12-5-1920 at Blagoves-
chensk-on-Amur is also known to have been connected with the
Oriental Express Company. He has criminal record the particulars
of which are as follows:-

(a) Misappropriation                      3 months imprisonment
    20-4-42                               suspended for 2 years.
(b) Larceny                               40 days
    10-12-42

Following his release from gaol is reported to have been living
with Peregovsky family, and to have been casually employed in
connection with the Oriental Express Co's business as a driver
and worker. He is reported to have recently been divorced.
According to a report on file dated 5-6-42 he was an active mem-
ber of the local Soviet community and is connected with Soviet
intelligence service.

David M.KUCHMAK, born 22-12-1911 at Blagoveschensk -on- Amur.
Brother of the above two individuals.
Holds Soviet passport No.18477 issued at Tsitsicar. Arrived in
Shanghai in May, 1936 from Harbin. On 5-5-1942 was married.
Resides at 67 Rte Vallon. (formerly resided at 19 Rte Doumer /
Pao Chia Guarantors: U.Teregovsky and V.Litvin residing at 40
Rte de Prouchy. Reported to be working as a broker, commission age
